notes.title: Nuclear Desaster Update

tags.feature: - What I consider most important about this update is that we have a new map! Why did I decide to create another one? It turns out that this first map (Medium City) was too closed for our proposal. The objective of the game is to control regions by means of flags, something that becomes more fun on a larger and more open map.
- Now it is also possible to take stone from the landscape (as wood is taken from trees).
- Dedicated server saving all progress every hour.
- Now you can swim in the pool in every house.
- Now you don't unequip the Canteen or the Water Bottle when you start swimming, which makes it easier to fill it.
- Now the main menu scene is nocturnal.
- Now the interaction words are locked on the object, instead of being targeted.
- Now we have a tutorial for new players.
- "Nuclear Disaster" map created.
- Now we have a map that can be built with 5 clothes.
- New foods added.
- Constructions with 100% more life when all members of the group are offline.
- Recently added writings translated into Portuguese.

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
I decided to hold this update a bit to make a bigger update with more changes. This saves me time, as I don't need to package and upload to Steam. Unfortunately, it taked longer(really longer) than I thought due to some reworked systems. I hope you haven't been bored.

I want you to know that we already fix most of bugs, wich makes we close to Beta Version. I decided to call "Beta" the version wich has all the basic systems implemented, so we have a lot of features comming. The next 3 versions will be focused in to fix other bugs and change some things, then we will work in features that will make the game diferent to others survival games(for now we bring nothing new in this market). Also, i'll start to work in bring new players to make a cool player's flux in the oficial server.

Features and Changes:
- Changed the way you create a dedicated server. Now you have to download it separate to the game, still in steam(tutorial will be updated soon).
- Now you can only open bronze and iron chests placed by a allied party member(others chests everyone can open). Hosts can always open chests(when in LAN).
- Decrease items spawn's probability(75% to 50%) in their spawn window, but fixed bug that item only spawn when you are closer.
- Reworked archery system to fix bugs.
- Changed arrow gravity and velocity.
- Changed FOV - Field of View(90º to 100º)
- Changed animal spawns probability(1/10 chance to spawn hawk, 3/10 chicken and 2/10 others, against 1/5 each previously).
- Changed shoots gravity and velocity(was too fast).
- Reworked shooting system to fix bugs.
- Now coal made by camp fire has a properly slot.
- Fixed slot did not update when the first wood was burned at the campfire.
- Some performance improvements.
- Improvements and changes in Jump animation.
- Now food made by stick has a properly slot.
- Scaled some ladders to make easier to climb.
- Now when selecting a hotkey you just select it, so you have to left click(anywhere) to use it.
- The game are now translated to English and Portuguese.

Fixes:
- Fixed(?) bug that after respawning you loss your HUD. It was a bug caused by high ping. As this only happened when the ping was high it was hard to test, but i redo the system, and it is pretty solid now. Anyway if it happens with someone again, please report.
- Fixed bug that hit notice do not appear when shooting a player.
- Fixed when leaving and rejoining a game your sensitivity resets.
- Fixed cannot place containers on ceilings.
- Fixed containers overlapping objects.
- Fixed not being possible to place doors and windows in some buildings.
- Fixed door rotation bug.
- Fixed when passing trough a doorframe the character flicks.
- Fixed animation freeze after jumping.
- Fixed hitting while in Escape menu.
- Fixed when equipping the Cloth pants the feet change his texture.
- Fixed the hand in the middle of screen when aiming with Blazer or Honey(only happened when low res).
- Fixed arrow still in the hand when change weapon shooting with bow(now it is shooted when change weapon).
- Fixed on start to build chest all chest objects are the Clay Chest.
- Fixed all chests named as "clay chest".
- Fixed not possible to drop from Equipment slot to inventory or world.
- Fixed food and drink bar getting crazy on LAN hoster.
- Fixed spawnables's bugs.

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
This update we focused in the save system and some fixes.
Features:
- Now you can create up to 8 saves to play in LAN.
- Now you can delete a previous save.
- Save/load system created in Dedicated Server(now when connected, if you had already played in that server, you load your items and position).

Fixes:
- Reworked the system of earning initial items to correct related bugs(whenever you loaded a LAN game your first two items were replaced with a torch and stone, and equipped items were deleted).
- Fixed bug that everytime that you try to start a new LAN game the previously game is loaded.
- Fixed bug that you cant place walls above stairs(now you can put one wall on top of the other)
- Client's game is generating logs again in path: "C: \ Users{UserName} \ AppData \ Local \ Countrified \ Saved \ Logs".

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
That was a pretty rushed update, to fix bugs that was crashing the gameplay. It caused some bugs that will be fixed soon, but everything below is working now.

Fixes:
- Fixed sometimes not showing your items in the in-game inventory.
- Fixed the bug of not being able to create a chest. The toggle of the party widget was conflicting with the chest shortcut. Now the toggle is in the letter 'O'.
- In-game options menu now working perfectly.
- Bug where you cannot open buildings (fire, furnace, etc.) fixed.
- Bug of not showing spawnable items on the official server fixed.
- Bug of not appearing resources on the official server fixed.

Features:
- Possibility to drink water directly from the well.

Remembering that you can interact directly with the developers and community through the official discord: https://discord.gg/4FkChQw

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
[i]Português no final do post.[/i]
EN:
Hello guys. I am pretty happy with you guys playing, sending feedbacks, screenshots and somethings. Well, that is my frist game and i am trying hard to do something great. This is the first update since the launch. We fixed some bugs and added features that will make the game more interactive. Hope you enjoy it, stay sending feedbacks, is pretty important, thanks!

New features:
- Party system.
- Global chat.

Bug Fixes:
- Fish walking on grass.
- Store bugs.
- Animation usually freezing when looking down.

PT/BR:
Olá pessoal. Estou muito feliz com vocês jogando, enviando feedbacks, screenshots e outras coisas. Bem, esse é o meu primeiro jogo e estou me esforçando para fazer algo grande. Esta é a primeira atualização desde o lançamento. Corrigimos alguns bugs e adicionamos recursos que tornarão o jogo mais interativo. Espero que gostem, continue enviando feedbacks, é bem importante, obrigado!

Recursos adicionados:
- Sistema de grupo.
- Chat global.

Correções:
- Peixe andando em terra firme.
- Vários bugs da loja.
- Bug da animação do personagem travando eventualmente.
